description: This Java class 'CurrentMongoStatus' represents the health status of a MongoDB instance, encapsulating whether it is alive and providing an optional description. It includes constructors, getters, and overridden methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: CurrentMongoStatus
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates the MongoDB health status, including whether it is alive and an optional descriptive message.

methods.name: CurrentMongoStatus
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the status with whether MongoDB is alive and an optional description.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Returns whether MongoDB is considered alive.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the description regarding the MongoDB status.
